correctness.rationale: The proof gives an exact invertible correspondence between isotone C3-valued grid labelings and two nested decreasing Ferrers boundaries; the local maximal-zero criterion is necessary and sufficient for back at all source points. Rank-standardization bijects maps of each weak order type with binomial choices, and strict top-rank interleavings are Catalan by reflection principle. MacMahon unrestricted counts and inclusion-exclusion supply the comparison asymptotic. Exhaustive four-boundary weak-order coefficient table and standalone independent direct enumeration confirm the two-row polynomial. No finite test is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The rectangular product of chains is a canonical branching Kripke source; the three-world chain is the smallest target for which a surjective monotone map can fail the upward back condition. An all-width positive coefficient census, Catalan leading coefficient, fixed-width near-certainty of back, and explicit first-branching-width obstruction counts distinguish logical quotient morphisms from ordinary boxed plane partitions. These are natural reproducible enumerative invariants, not merely an unmotivated finite case.
